import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class BackButton extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        canGoBack: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        fallbackHref: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        dirty: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        requestConfirmation: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        pending: {
            state: boolean;
        };
        failure: {
            state: boolean;
        };
    };
    canGoBack: boolean;
    fallbackHref: string;
    dirty: boolean;
    requestConfirmation: (() => boolean | Promise<boolean>) | undefined;
    private pending;
    private failure;
    private generation;
    constructor();
    disconnectedCallback(): void;
    private activate;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
